456:t_018:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No way! He stopped me!」

456:t_018:2.en:
$$ジン$$
「It's been a while, $$シンジ$$. I'm glad to see you again.」

456:t_018:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Switch with me, $$ジン$$! I'll go after that bastard $$ミカゲ$$!」

456:t_018:5.en:
$$ジン$$
「If Chairwoman $$クレア$$ gives her permission.」

456:t_018:6.en:
$$クレア$$
「Very well. ...Element change! $$カグラ・デムリ$$ into $$ゲパルト$$!」

456:t_019:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$カグラ$$, $$ジン$$... You turn your blades against me yet again?」

456:t_019:1.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Until you stop taking your revenge out on everyone, I'll take you on as many times as it takes!」

456:t_020:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's sad... to be left behind by the cycle of reincarnation and refuse to accept change...」

456:t_020:1.en:
$$不動$$
「Is his hatred so deep because of his love...?」

456:t_020:6.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Please save him... Save $$ミカゲ$$.」

456:t_021:1.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... He comes and goes as suddenly as ever.」

456:t_021:2.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「By the way, when did Chairwoman $$クレア$$ get aboard the $$クォーター$$?」

456:t_021:3.en:
$$クレア$$
「There is no need to worry about the details. More to the point...」

456:t_021:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now things are getting exciting!」

456:t_022:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Anyway, that washed-up Shadow Angel has gone home. Now let's have some fun ourselves!」

456:t_022:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Is that all you ever think about?!」

456:t_022:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Huh...? Is that bad?」

456:t_022:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Talking to you is a waste of time!」

456:t_022:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Haha! You should be true to yourself too, darling!」

456:t_023:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「She has unleashed her desires...!」

456:t_023:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「To crave battle for its own sake...!」

456:t_023:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「This looks fun...! After sleeping for 12,000 years, she'll be just the opponent to wake me up!」

456:t_023:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「$$アポロ$$! After $$アクエリオン$$'s long sleep, it seems it can't separate or transform!」

456:t_023:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「You handle the head! Use our power!」

456:t_023:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! I'll fight for everyone who couldn't be here too!」

456:t_023:6.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That's what I'd expect from the original Elements! They're fired up!」

456:t_023:7.en:
$$カグラ$$
「We can't let them outdo us, $$アマタ$$!」

456:t_024:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「With $$カグラ$$ here, $$ＥＶＯＬ$$ has more weapons it can use! Let's do this!」

456:t_024:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Hold on, $$アマタ$$! We're the stars today!」

456:t_024:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「All right, $$アポロ$$. I'll let you have the spotlight just for today.」

456:t_025:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That $$アポロ$$ is $$アマタ$$'s previous incarnation, after all.」

456:t_025:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「So their souls are connected. No wonder they hit it off so quickly.」

456:t_025:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go, guys! If you've gotten rusty while I was asleep, I'm gonna laugh at you!」

456:t_025:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you're still half asleep, I'll whack you awake with my $$ジャレンチ$$!」

456:t_025:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I doubt we need to worry about that with $$アポロ$$.」

456:t_025:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Show us! Let us see $$アクエリオン$$'s usual crazy tricks!」

456:t_025:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「And the sun's brilliance within you!」

456:t_025:8.en:
$$シリウス$$
「We're ready whenever you are, $$アポロ$$!」

456:t_025:10.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! I won't show any mercy to bastards who use force to do whatever they want with the world!」

456:t_026:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're good! It'd be a shame to settle things on a battlefield I only dropped into by chance!」

456:t_026:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then I'll admit I lost today. You really have gotten stronger.」

456:t_026:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The feeling I had when we first fought at $$ラース・バビロン$$... I was right after all.」

456:t_026:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Bye, darling! Let's have some fun on $$蒼の地球$$ next time!」

456:t_027:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The fighting between us and the Shadow Angels has opened a gap in $$蒼の地球$$'s defenses.」

456:t_027:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So we can descend to Earth now.」

456:t_027:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Call a briefing immediately. $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ will now move its battlefield to $$蒼の地球$$.」

456:t_027:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...Earth sure got into a hell of a mess while I was taking a nap.」

456:t_027:6.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I never imagined there would be two Earths.」

456:t_027:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「$$アルテア$$ and $$ヴェーガ$$ were born thanks to you guys, after all.」

456:t_027:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'll hear the details later. First...」

456:t_027:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I figured it'd be something like that.」

456:t_027:12.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Welcome, $$アポロ$$. Let's fight together again.」

456:t_027:14.en:
$$アポロ$$
「But there's something I've gotta do first.」
